Media Digest: Can Journalism Be Funny?
An interview with comedian-reporter Mary Houlihan
Journalism and AI:
Addressing Fears, Anxieties, and Concerns
Wednesday, October 28, 2026
10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET
Free to attend
In this webinar panel, three seasoned journalists —
Taylor Lorenz
,
Alexandra Marvar
, and
Brian Merchant
— will share how media workers can navigate AI tools and the various ways in which this technology has transformed the industry.
This panel will touch upon how legacy media outlets are coming up with AI rules, and what writers can do to protect their work. In addition, the panelists will discuss larger questions about how AI has changed the industry: Is it possible to integrate these tools in a workflow without plagiarizing other writers' work? Is there a double standard of media outlets banning freelancers from using these tools, while editors use in-house AI tools? What does it mean to have original prose in a time when LLMs can mimic style?

Will Coldwell Reported On An Injustice In The World of Merchant Shipping
For
The Guardian
, Will Coldwell "took a closer look at the case of Ali Albokhari, a Finnish seafarer who was arrested in October 2023 after Turkish police found cocaine on board his cargo ship. While no evidence has been presented linking Ali to the drugs, he was convicted on the basis of 'command responsibility' and sentenced to 30 years. The case reveals much about the fragile systems that hold maritime infrastructure together, and the way seafarers can slip between the cracks – falling victim to negligent companies, corrupt states and criminal enterprises. While Ali's story has been widely reported in the maritime press it has had little coverage elsewhere. This in itself speaks to a gap in public understanding relating to the complex – and worsening – conditions facing seafarers."
William Antonelli Profiled the Carpenters Who Set Up Every Single Event at the Jacob Javits Center
For
Under Construction News
, William Antonelli toured "NYC'S famous Jacob Javits Convention Center, talked to the union carpenters who work there, and wrote about the work they do building (and building and building and building) the walls, booths, and stages for every event that comes through the Center."
Alessandra Bergamin Reported On The Environmental Impact of The War in Southern Lebanon
For
Truthout
, Alessandra Bergamin wrote about "land and environmental defenders killed by Israel in Southern Lebanon and how their deaths are tied to the ongoing destruction of the region."
